none: PAS NLM-9F4366: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine from Crowle
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Constantinopolis issue of 330-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Helmeted bust of Constantinopolis left. Obverse inscription: [CONSTANT]INOPOLIS. Reverse description: Victory with shield advancing left on prow; Victory is unusually bat winged in appearance. Diameter: 15.3mm, Weight: 1.76gms, die axis: 6
